dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Travel information here! Inquiries welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there. And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Haha, not to brag or anything, but I'm probably the most responsible and reliable tour guide in the entire tribe!

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: I'll provide you with the best vacation plan, and stay on your beck and call, always available to get you through any issues you may encounter during your stay here!

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: I've got every kind of connection within the tribe, so if you need anything here, I've got you covered.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you!

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Ah, leaving already? Well don't forget to come find me if you ever need a tour guide!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what have you got around here?

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Travelers from distant lands can first have a taste of the local cuisine, before enjoying a live music performance and checking out the exquisitely-made records.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Once you've recovered from that, you can try out all the water sports we have to offer, and have a jolly good time.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: If your arms and legs are sore, just have a good soak in the hot springs, and you'll be back up in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Come evening, visit the Golden Dusk to watch the sunset and have a nice, iced drink, and that'll be the perfect way to wrap up your day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well arranged. I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Haha, it's the least I can do. Every visitor to our land should get to experience everything we have to offer!

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Interested in the stuff I mentioned? I'll even book everything for you. All you need to do is show up and enjoy.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Oh, and please feel free to bring your friends! The more the merrier!

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: Mom... For all these years, have you really never felt the need to bring everyone together to expand the family business?

dialogues.speaker: Kupo Nui
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why would you ask something like that, my child? Everyone in the family is gainfully employed. Won't you say that they're all hard at work in their own individual spheres?

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I mean! Instead of each focusing on our own thing, why can't we bring everyone together, so we can all work towards the same goal, and help each other grow?

dialogues.speaker: Kupo Nui
dialogues.text: Ahh, I see. Well, if that's how you feel, why not bring it up with the group?

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: *sigh*... But none of them are willing to give me the time of day. It feels like they're all happy to just stick to the status quo...

dialogues.speaker: Kupo Nui
dialogues.text: Ah, is that so? Then you should also be happy for them.

dialogues.speaker: Wakea Nui
dialogues.text: I can be happy for them, I guess, but I'm a little sad for myself. At this rate, I'll never get a second employee for my international travel agency...
